fields.Name: Skip ICF - Conference Attendees Without Courses
fields.Description: Members who attended the conference (Event Order Lines AttendanceStatus=Attended) but never enrolled in a course (MoreCheese: Course Enrollments). Ported from "Members with Events but No Courses".

InputDefinition.userMessage: Find all members who have attended at least one of our conferences but have never enrolled in a course. Show me a table with their names, segment, and how many conferences they attended. I want to click on a member to see which conferences they attended. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a table of members matching the criteria
Attendance is based on Event Order Lines with AttendanceStatus = Attended
Members with any course enrollment are excluded
Each row shows the member's name, segment and number of conferences attended
Clicking a member shows the conferences (registrations) they attended
Rows in the member table can open the underlying person or member profile record
